scope: Whole native AOT compiler CLI and image emission; correctness preparation before any timing

selection: Exclude .d.nupp declaration inputs from explicit standalone checks; dependencies still resolve normally
cold-check.cache: Fresh explicit NUPP_CACHE_DIR and removed disposable project build state; fresh process, OS filesystem cache uncontrolled

warm-check.cache: One untimed priming check per compiler in separate source copy and cache; fresh measured process against preserved cache; actual compiled/reused module counts retained

emit.cache: Full project.emit with cache=false; fresh process and output for each run

correctness: All6214 functions have linked AOT entries, no emitter refusals; NO_JIT1 and NO_AOT absent for native runs
Native full emit must equal its own frozen controller reference output byte for byte
Source checks must succeed with identical empty diagnostics
Cross-controller image equality is not required because intended compiler lowering differs
metrics: Whole process wall seconds including image loading, checking/lowering and output
Direct measured-child peak RSS and CPU from wait4; platform units converted to bytes
Compiler-reported check timing and compiled/reused module counts
Full emit compiled frame entry count

measurementPolicy.order: Alternate baseline/candidate order per pair; no competing agent CPU work
measurementPolicy.interval: 95 percent paired log-ratio bootstrap, 10000 resamples; process pairs are samples
measurementPolicy.verdicts: improved if upper CI<0.98; regressed if lower CI>1.02; unchanged if CI within[0.98,1.02]; otherwise inconclusive

targets.wholeCLI: Report absolute wall time and paired ratio; no established absolute source-check target in plan
targets.backend: Existing target at most1ms/function and at least10x Cranelift optimizer-off on same corpus; not inferred from whole-CLI timings
targets.historicalTotalBudget: 11ms/function context from backend plan; not a source-check acceptance threshold

limitations: Native compiler functions currently use the frozen Cranelift AOT object emitter. This proves compiled Nupp compiler source and native execution, not replacement of the AOT machine-code backend by S0.
No filesystem cache purge; cold means compiler cache cold only.
Native frame continuation/driver transitions remain part of runtime; all-function attachment and entry counters prevent silently substituting a NO_AOT run.
preparationRefusal: Minimal aot-linked,native-runtime pair passed full emit identity, but full CLI check requires c-headers; first refusal and minimal binaries preserved.
preparationSelectionCorrection: The initial200-file glob included9 declarations; standalone prelude check reports NUPP2131 for self.close. Preserve that receipt and select191 implementation files.
